store_origins.title: Store origins
store_origins.description: Public HTTPS origins, one per line, for example https://shop.example.com. Origins only: a path, a query string or credentials in the URL are refused before any request is made. Duplicates are asked once.

requested_families.title: Surface families to check
requested_families.description: Leave empty for the server's default set.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Deliberately small. The upstream preflight is rate limited per origin and per caller IP, and a bigger number returns rate-limit rows, not faster answers.
